agent.notes: Full install failed (torchaudio has no cp312 wheel; lancedb==0.12.0 unresolvable), so both venvs were rebuilt on Python 3.11 with bolna installed --no-deps plus only the deps the azure_synthesizer import chain needs (azure-cognitiveservices-speech 1.38.0, dotenv, aiobotocore, torch, scipy, websockets, openai, pydub, numpy, etc.). The workload runs AzureSynthesizer.generate() over 150 synthesizer instances x 10 messages (plus a cache hit and SSML speeds), then calls cleanup(). Only the Azure cloud client speechsdk.SpeechSynthesizer is replaced, by a local stand-in that delivers events synchronously through the handlers the code connects (needed because head hangs on `await chunk_queue.get()` when the completion callback arrives after the queue is drained, which always happened with a background-thread stand-in). Head also reconnects handlers on every reuse of a pooled synthesizer, so chunks are duplicated and the work grows quadratically with messages per synthesizer; the digest ignores duplicate chunks, so outputs are equal. check.py passes: base 2.7 s, head 5.2 s, coverage 92.5% base / 88.1% head. The background task that was killed was an early broken draft that never awaited push(); it is not needed.
